reviews.x: This mask is so ridiculous that it’s perfect !!! If you know this is all a plandemic and hate useless masks , but need something that they will let you in places , and  you want to breath because you love air ... than this is a perfect mask for you .!! I refuse to wear a useless cloth on my face .. caus it doesn’t stop the virus ! Only thing it does it suppresses you air intake ... this little plastic mask doesn’t cover ur mouth or nose , you can breath easily and they need to let you in places

reviews.t: Covers and protects without compromising breathing!!!
reviews.x: Love these masks!!! I can’t take the thick full medical masks anymore. I’ve been getting bad acne, marks all over my face, my nose runs, and also bloody noses from wearing those masks. I was very pleasantly surprised that this kind of mask fit my face perfectly and is 100% acceptable inside places. I don’t have a big face, so that’s maybe why it fits way better. With the medical masks they would swallow my face and ride up to my eyes. I was constantly pulling it down (touching it). Like I said e
Open your mouth and your nose is no longer covered.  Doesn’t provide the best protection.

reviews.t: Makes wearing a mask not so bad
reviews.x: Love it. Well as much as I can love a mask.
Love this mask and I can actually breathe wearing it
After having to wear a mask. This is a nice upgrade. I work in customer service,  so the visual smile is very important.

I can breathe with this mask and it seems to be accepted by all indoor locations.  I do air it out for a little bit before using the first time, they do break easy if not cared for but at $1 each, I just hang it from my dashboard.  There is a clear film to be removed. People can see your smile.  I am very grateful for the product.  Some come with a white chin band, I prefer the clear support plastic chin band.

I personally really like this product. I’m careful with COVID but I’m not scared of it. This mask keeps your nose and mouth secretions from normal breathing and talking behind a non-permeable barrier keeping others around you safe.( If you are sneezing and coughing a lot I’d probably still use a more enclosed cloth mask. ) These masks will not keep you safe, but then again there is debate as to weather the cloth ones do... anyhoo... you can breath in these. They do not fog up your glasses and yo
Not what I expected does not even cover nose.

Not sure what they are talking about when they say “anti fog” cause this things dogs up like crazy. That said, it’s as functional as any cloth mask and people can actually see you smile again. It’ll do for controlled states like NY.

reviews.t: Allows my toddler daughter to be able to read my lips when out in public
reviews.x: I love this mask/ shield. I feel like I am complying with mandate but also can still breathe and talk comfortably.  Also, since my toddler is low vision and low speech it still allows her to read my lips. Not all places accept these type of masks but Costco did😊
This works to keep the mask natzis away. It's fairly comfortable. It's way more comfortable than the suffocating masks. You can breathe. After it's on for a bit, you barely notice it.

reviews.t: A mask for people who dont like wearing masks
reviews.x: I dont wear a mask anywhere and always get hassled about it.  I've worn this to costco and other places that require a mask or face shield and even though this covers almost nothing on your face people are more concerned about compliance vs science.  I get a lot of looks because it doesnt cover anything but nobody has asked me to leave or put a different mask on.

I'm a paraeducator for special education students, one of my students is deaf. The need for this student to see my face is the breaking point for their education and this mask enables me the best. I've tried face/headbands shields and they interfere with my glasses, constant fogging, and intense glares, I cant see out of them and the kids cannot hear me. This mask has solved a lot of issues for me. I can do my job the most effectively in this mask, I can run without suffocating like cloth masks,

reviews.t: Just what it says it is, unfortunately not acceptable as "face covering".
reviews.x: It is exactly as it is advertised. Unfortunately, there's not many places that it's acceptable as a " face cover". Costco is one place that wouldn't allow this or me inside the warehouse. So, im bummed because now I have 10 of these that I can't really use. Even worse- I can't return it because I opened the box and the whole package inside. Plus, I used 1 to go to Costco and to convenient store. 😒😤👎😷

reviews.t: Great for high intensity workouts or the everyday.
reviews.x: I have been using these while working out for several weeks now and am loving them. They are minimally invasive and though they get covered in condensation, it does not inhibit my sight in the least as the full face shields can. Also, although I initially felt these must not be blocking much and are simply “fitting the bill” of having a face covering, they do seem to “catch” quite a bit...so maybe they are working better than I thought. The adjusters on the sides are nice and the ear loops are c

reviews.t: Not what it looks like. Extremely disappointed!!!!
reviews.x: talk or open your mouth and the whole top of mask goes down and off of your nose plus, Its not secure . It falls off your face . Very disappointed in these masks!!!!

Pros:  adjustable, clear, initially more comfortable than cloth masks Cons:  Fogs (both mask and my glasses), slowly tilts and rests up against the nose (and if you have a large head, your nose would sit right at the edge of the plastic (which wouldn't be too bad until you talk and the nose rides right on the edge of that sharp(ish) plastic))
These are junk. The size is horrible. The material is cheap.

Like that people can see when you smile.  Also love that you can get good fresh air!!  I do not like that you cannot adjust it to keep it from hitting your nose.  It would be great if the chin piece could adjust to move the shield a farther away from your nose.

reviews.t: Having a ponytail helps it work fine along with a connecting strap along back of head.
reviews.x: Neat concept but the ear elastic will not stay on and pulls off. I took a strap and connected the ear pieces across the back of my head which helped. The earpieces still popped off after a while so I laid the connecting strap over my pony tail and it didn't slide down onto the back of my neck. I was able to wear the shield like this for several hours without issues and it was comfortable. The chin piece helped the mask stay off my face. This will work if you have a connecting strap to attach to

Too small for my husband and I. Sheila rested on the tip of our noses, and when you talked your nose came out of the top, exposing it.  Either made for very petite people or children. Not for the average or tall American adult. I’m 5’ 10” tall and my husband is 6’ 4” tall. So I returned them.  Wish they would have worked since we both have had our COVID vaccinations. Had hoped they would not fog up our glasses, and allow others to see you smile.
It does fog up but fits just fine. My clients can now see my face. yay. Thank you. (Note: My male workers stated it doesn't fit for them--as they have larger proportioned faces)
I really like these. I have breathing problems and they make it easy for me to breathe while still covering my nose and mouth. I like how the bottom rests on my chin
These masks come over the nose but they are open at the top. You will get some flack from other people seeing you wearing it.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the mask for being easy to breathe in compared to thicker masks.
Several reviewers value that it lets others see their smile or read their lips, especially for work or accessibility.
A common complaint is that it does not cover the nose, leaving it exposed when talking or opening the mouth.
Some reviewers report it is accepted at indoor locations like Costco, while others say it is not accepted as a face covering.
A few reviewers note issues like fogging or breaking easily if not cared for.
